spots.name: Sichuan Museum
spots.summary: The Sichuan Museum is a public provincial museum in Chengdu, Sichuan, China. It is owned and funded by the Sichuan Provincial People's Government. Founded in 1941, the museum holds collections spanning the archeology, history, art, and ethnography of Sichuan and the wider Ba–Shu region.

spots.name: Temple of Marquis Wu, Chengdu
spots.summary: The temple is adjacent to Jinli Ancient Street, so visitors can combine both in one trip. Allow about 1.5 hours.This temple is built to commemorate Zhuge Liang (诸葛亮), who was the minister of Shu (蜀) in the Three Kingdoms Period. He is famous through the Chinese novel Romance of the Three Kingdoms. There are dozens of dust covered statues of obscure historical figures behind glass and not much else

spots.name: Du Fu Thatched Cottage
spots.summary: Du Fu Thatched Cottage is a 24-acre (97,000 m2) park and museum in honour of the Tang dynasty poet Du Fu at the western outskirts of Chengdu, adjacent to the Huanhua Xi. In 1961 the Chinese government made the cottage a National Heritage site.

spots.name: Anshun Bridge
spots.summary: The Anshun Bridge is a bridge in Chengdu, Sichuan, China. It crosses the Jin River. The covered bridge contains a relatively large restaurant and is a popular eating location in the city.

spots.name: Tianfu Square
spots.summary: This square, overlooked by an enormous Chairman Mao statue in the center of the city, has been spruced up. Every evening at dusk, as well as at noontime, an elaborate water show, synchronized to music, bursts out from the square's fountains. Below the square is the hub of Chengdu's subway system. In the subway entrance plaza, a small shopping mall has been built, almost literally under Mao's nose.

spots.name: Jinli
spots.summary: Jinli is a street in Chengdu, Sichuan, China. Its history can be traced back to the pre-Qin Dynasty era more than 1800 years ago. Jinli was ranked first in "the world's most beautiful streets" published by CNN Travel in 2019.

spots.name: People's Park
spots.summary: People's Park is an urban public park in central Chengdu, capital of Sichuan province, China. Built in 1911 as Shaocheng Park (少城公园), it is the first public park in the city. The Railway Protection Movement Monument in the park is designated a Major Historical and Cultural Site of China.

spots.name: Wenshu Temple
spots.summary: Wenshu Temple, or Wenshu Monastery, is a Buddhist temple located in Qingyang, Chengdu, Sichuan, China.

spots.name: Tomb of Wang Jian
spots.summary: The Yongling Mausoleum, commonly known as the tomb of Wang Jian, is the burial place of Wang Jian (847–918), the founding emperor of Former Shu. It is located at 10 Yongling Road, Jinniu District, Chengdu, Sichuan, China.

spots.name: Jinsha Site Museum
spots.summary: 金沙遗址博物馆是展示四川地区古蜀文化的博物馆，金沙遗址是古蜀城邑遗址。

spots.name: Jinsha site
spots.summary: Jinsha is a Chinese archaeological site located in Qingyang, Chengdu, the capital of the Chinese province of Sichuan. The site is one of the major archaeological discoveries in China during the 21st century.

spots.summary: Daci Temple is a Buddhist temple located in Jinjiang, Chengdu, Sichuan, China.

spots.name: Kuanzhai Xiangzi
spots.summary: Very nice place with lots of (expensive) tea houses, restaurants and local snacks. Great for relaxing. Streets date from late Qing-dynasty style but have been rebuilt. Free government Wi-Fi in this place.

spots.name: Chengdu Museum
spots.summary: Chengdu Museum is a public municipal museum in Chengdu, Sichuan, China.

spots.name: Azure Ram Temple
spots.summary: This Taoist temple is the oldest and biggest of its kind in the area, located in the west of downtown. A large and still-active temple that takes into consideration Taoist philosophy in its construction, and with both a park next door and a number of relaxed courtyards inside. While it has a long history, the buildings are modern, cheaply-made concrete constructions, and it quite frequently shows.

spots.summary: The Chengdu Huangcheng Mosque is a mosque in Qingyang District, Chengdu, in the Sichuan province of China. It is the largest mosque in Sichuan.

spots.name: Sichuan Science and Technology Museum
spots.summary: The Sichuan Science and Technology Museum is a provincial public science museum in central Chengdu, Sichuan, China. It is owned and funded by the Sichuan Provincial People's Government. The museum is located immediately north of Tianfu Square in Qingyang District.

spots.name: Monument to the Martyrs of the Railway Protection Movement
Chengdu Culture Park
spots.summary: The Chengdu Culture Park is an urban park in the city of Chengdu, Sichuan, China.

spots.name: Chengdu Zoo
spots.summary: Chengdu Zoo is a zoo located in Chengdu, China. It is home to around 3,000 animals representing 300 species and is China's fourth largest zoo. It is the largest zoo in southwest China.

spots.name: Sichuan Provincial Library

hours.note: Closed Sun; Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: Sichuan Provincial Library is the provincial public library of Sichuan, China, located in Qingyang, Chengdu. It is the largest library in Western China and one of the ten largest libraries in the country. The library was officially established in October 1912 and is the second oldest public library in China.

spots.summary: Fugan Temple was a famous Buddhist temple in Chengdu, Sichuan province, China. It was established during the Eastern Jin (317–420), and remained in use until the Southern Song (1127–1279). It later fell into disrepair, and was eventually lost.

spots.name: 春熙路
spots.summary: 春熙路是成都最繁华的商业街，也是中国大陆知名的商业街之一，由春熙东路、春熙西路、春熙南路、春熙北路四条步行街组成。春熙路广义上也指由它为中心发展成的春熙路商圈，商圈指总府路以南、上东大街以北、红星路以西、盐市口以东约0.4平方公里的地区，是成都老城区三大商圈之一。

spots.summary: A local restaurant serving Fushun-style sour-pickle tofu pudding hot pot. The restaurant is known for its affordable prices, generous portions, and free refills of tofu pudding. Popular dishes include tofu pudding with crispy pork, beef, and pork ribs.
